decisions.reason: As the flagship organic line with several variants, strong fit to the firm's stated direction, and no sign of results below aspiration, it is likely to be retained.

This premium sharing snack still uses familiar salami capabilities and can be carried with some organisational slack, though the firm will monitor whether sales meet aspirations after the snack-related pruning seen with Product B.

The new organic Fleischwurst extends the core range and likely gets more time to prove itself, but as a recent single-product launch it faces a moderate withdrawal risk if early retail uptake falls short of aspiration.
The organic chicken-breast line fits the expansion into organic and ingredient-conscious sliced meats, and its several variants justify continued support unless performance clearly underwhelms.

The organic herb-coated salami is close to the firm's curing strengths, but as a narrower 2024 niche launch without the backing of a broader line it is the most exposed if management reallocates resources to better-performing products.
